QuestInfo.name: Elma's New Look 3
QuestInfo.0: #bElma the Housekeeper#k in #bOrbis Park#k has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Elma the Housekeep seems much happier than before, and wants new earrings to finish her look. It seems she's stopped doing her job... As long as her master doesn't come home, it should be fine.\n\n#i1032014##t1032014#  #b#c1032014# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: Elma finished dolling herself up. You might not recognize her the next time you meet.

0.0: #h0#! It's so lovely to see you! I've been having a blast prettying myself up. Isn't my skin so much clearer? Well, I still have freckles, but still!
0.1: Okay, I'm not too sure about the treatments. But I could certainly use a new accessory, don't you think?

yes.0: I would love a pair of #bPink-Flowered Earrings#k. They're just the most charming things ever! I'd like hand-crafted earrings, but I don't think I could tell the difference if you picked them off a monster.

no.0: No? Come on. Well, I suppose there's always the internet... or the Free Market...

1.0: Oh, do you have the earrings? Let me try them on.

yes.0: Oh...! These are high-level earrings! They're cute, but am I strong enough to wear them? Well, the master's not coming home anytime soon. He won't notice if I go around and level up for a while, right?

item.0: No #bPink-Flowered Earrings#k yet? A Jeweler would have no trouble making them... Monsters don't drop them too often.
